questions.stem: In a laboratory experiment, both Staphylococcus epidermidis and Escherichia coli were cultured on the same media. After overnight incubation, it was observed that only E. coli showed significant growth, while S. epidermidis did not grow at all. What could be the most likely reason for this difference in the growth observed in the culture?
questions.stemHtml: In a laboratory experiment, both Staphylococcus epidermidis and Escherichia coli were cultured on the same media. After overnight incubation, it was observed that only E. coli showed significant growth, while S. epidermidis did not grow at all. What could be the most likely reason for this difference in the growth observed in the culture?

options.label: A
options.text: Temperature of growth was set wrong

options.label: C
options.text: E. coli produced colicin that inhibited S. epidermidis growth

options.label: D
options.text: Gram positives have more generation time
